name: dsh-origin-plugin

one_liner.zh: 通过 MCP 驱动本机 Origin 绘图、分析和交付
one_liner.en: Drive local Origin plotting, analysis, and delivery through MCP

external_services.purpose: Search and fetch public Origin graph gallery templates

local: Windows with Origin or OriginPro installed for COM automation
Python 3.10+ and the Python dependencies in requirements.txt
DSH bundle uses the system Python by default; standalone MCP clients can launch origin_mcp_stdio.py

config_items.description: Optional Python interpreter path used by the launcher and unload hook

config_items.name: ORIGIN_MCP_PROFILE
config_items.description: Set to compact to hide the extended statistics tools

config_items.name: ORIGIN_SESSION
config_items.description: Set to isolated to avoid connecting when an Origin process is already running

code.reason: The source separates MCP registration, planning, file parsing, analysis, and editing, with structured errors and readback checks.
